items.title: Show HN: Fast, Zero Allocation, AOT Safe, Compile-Time Safe .NET Template Engine
items.contentSnippet: I built a text templating engine, that I've named Lissic, as part of a personal website project I'm working on.  It fits a niche that I don't think anything else in the .NET ecosystem fills.  I prefer to keep code out the template itself (separation of concerns, view vs model, and all that).  I also wanted to build something simple enough that I could imagine low/medium-tech UI dev working with it, but it still needs to build things in a modular way, support loops, support conditional/branching

items.title: Show HN: Full Python 3.15 Implemented in 25k LoC C11
items.contentSnippet:
I burned about $500 for this fun project: Small Python.
Initial PoC used 3 resets of Codex in one session but all later development happens in Claude Code, also in one Opus 5.5 session over three days.
The outcome is a quickjs-like implementation for Python.
Almost full Python 3.15 language features plus builtins are covered.
No Lib/  support.
Great for embedding scenarios.
No rust. Just plain C11 code.
Repo is here: https://github.com/soasme/small-python/
Ask me anything.
